title: In 1929, Tennessee farmer refused $20 an acre, then lost his farm

Oliver refused to sell his 375-acre Cades Cove farm for $20 an acre, leading to a lengthy court battle over land wanted for Great Smoky Mountains National Park. content: the timing of the visit depends on the PM's schedule, state minister for foreign affairs says . "if everything fits together, of course there will be a visit to India," a state minister said . india has sought the extradition of former prime minister sheikh Hasina .

title: Sniper, knife, missile threats: Israel warned US of alleged Iran plot to assassinate Trump
content: the warnings were passed to US intelligence agencies and directly to senior white house officials . the most detailed alert came ahead of Trump's trip to turkey for the Nato summit in July . despite the lack of verification, the white house and secret service took precautionary measures .

title: Uttarakhand: 7 dead after water, debris enter under-construction tunnel in Chamoli
content: the incident was reported around 7.05pm in the 2km-long Tail Race Tunnel . a landslide caused a cavity to form in an under-construction THDC tunnel . fourteen workers were rescued and admitted to a hospital .

title: US sends new carrier to Middle East amid reports of mental health crisis on USS Lincoln
content: the carrier swap is part of a previously planned rotation . concerns over crew morale and conditions aboard the Lincoln have raised questions . the move comes as families and lawmakers have raised alarm over reports that sailors have experienced severe burnout and deteriorating living conditions after more than 250 days at sea .
